paired_reveal_note: Thunderbolts* (released May 2025) and The Fantastic Four: First Steps (released July 2025) form a matched narrative pair: Thunderbolts' post-credits scene shows the Fantastic Four's ship arriving in Earth-616, while First Steps' mid-credits scene (set in the Fantastic Four's own timeline) shows Doom approaching Franklin Richards 4 years later. These are NOT strictly sequential — they depict parallel/converging timelines, and both were directed by the Russo brothers during Doomsday production.
